request.prompt: Create one original photorealistic game environment base-color texture: aged warm grey lime plaster of an ordinary northern Chinese town wall circa the 1930s. Full-frame material surface, orthographic front view, uniform diffuse illumination, no perspective, no directional shadows, no ambient occlusion, no highlights, no vignette. Fine gritty plaster, subtle rain streaks, small irregular patches of flaking limewash exposing muted grey-brown brick underneath. Restrained weathering, believable human-scale surface representing about two meters square. Consistent detail across the entire square, suitable for a physically based game material. No people, text, signage, symbols, doors, windows, border, watermark, dramatic lighting or cinematic composition. Make opposite edges match for seamless tiling.

Weathered unpainted wooden door boards in an ordinary northern Chinese town circa the 1930s. The square covers about 1.9 meters horizontally and 2.45 meters vertically. No dramatic rot, no moss, no peeling paint, not a finished rendered doorway.

Create an original grayscale game decal MASK atlas on a pure white 1024x1024 background, arranged as four separate 512x512 square cells in a clean 2 by 2 layout. No labels, grid lines, color, wall texture, lighting, people, letters, borders, or watermark. Black represents opaque grime and white represents empty space. Every stain must fade smoothly to pure WHITE on ALL FOUR edges of its own cell, leaving a white margin. Top-left: broad irregular low wall damp patch, denser near its lower middle, thin vertical rising moisture marks. Top-right: several narrow vertical rain runoff trails, stronger in the upper middle and tapering down unevenly, for below a windowsill. Bottom-left: sparse mud splash specks and faint soil stains concentrated low. Bottom-right: soft irregular mottled mildew patch, scattered tiny spots with gaps, not a solid rectangle. Restrained weathered surfaces of ordinary old buildings; no cracks, bullets, craters or holes.
